A '''colony''' established by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Herios IV]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The colony was overseen by an [[Unidentified Imperial governor (Herios IV)|Imperial governor]].<ref name="GG10">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref>
